title: EARLY CHILDHOOD EDUCATION METHODS
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the language spoken in a particular area or by a particular group especially one that is not the official or written language. (Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary Wehmair, 2000)."
Vernacular means the language spoken in a particular area or by a particular group especially one that is not the official or written language. (Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary Wehmair, 2000).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the education given in an educational institution to children prior to their entering the primary school."
Early childhood education is the education given in an educational institution to children prior to their entering the primary school.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a learning process which requires team work among learners."
Discussion is a learning process which requires team work among learners.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that we should build the necessary foundation for more demanding learning tasks."
Simplicity in learning means that we should build the necessary foundation for more demanding learning tasks.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the type of grouping used in a pre-school mainly in physical education."
Sex grouping is the type of grouping used in a pre-school mainly in physical education.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used for teaching reading at pre-school levels."
Phonics method is used for teaching reading at pre-school levels.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a description or account of things that have happened."
A story is a description or account of things that have happened.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the co-operative study of a real life situation by a class under the guidance of a teacher."
A project is the co-operative study of a real life situation by a class under the guidance of a teacher.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the idealists who believe that a child must be compelled through strict discipline to absorb the principles and standards of spiritual life."
Similar to the traditionalist is the idealists who believe that a child must be compelled through strict discipline to absorb the principles and standards of spiritual life.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the use of educational knowledge, methods and space to educate whosoever desires to be educated."
Teaching is the use of educational knowledge, methods and space to educate whosoever desires to be educated.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an environment where the requisite teaching/learning materials and conditions are present and in which the pupils feel comfortable, interested and are enthusiastic to learn."

Conducive teaching/learning environment per se is an environment where the requisite teaching/learning materials and conditions are present and in which the pupils feel comfortable, interested and are enthusiastic to learn.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a system of education and a philosophy of human development and learning."
Montessori method is a system of education and a philosophy of human development and learning.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a method where the teacher acts as the facilitator."
Teacher - Centered Method is a method where the teacher acts as the facilitator.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used when the subject matter to be learned by pupils can be looked at from several dimensions."
Team teaching approach is used when the subject matter to be learned by pupils can be looked at from several dimensions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a method of teaching where the children are more active than the teacher."
Child - Centered method is a method of teaching where the children are more active than the teacher.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the type of grouping where children are chosen in a haphazard way to form groups-no criteria are used."
Random grouping is the type of grouping where children are chosen in a haphazard way to form groups-no criteria are used.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the same as a group of six."
Three groups of two pencils is the same as a group of six.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a method in which the class is divided into small groups for a particular learning activity."
Group method is a method in which the class is divided into small groups for a particular learning activity.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first formal education given to the children in an educational institution to children aged three to five years plus. (National policy on Education (Federal Republic of Nigeria (FRN), 2004 P.11))."

Pre - school is the first formal education given to the children in an educational institution to children aged three to five years plus. (National policy on Education (Federal Republic of Nigeria (FRN), 2004 P.11)).
